verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, but the evidence pack documents no bulk export or account-exit feature. Scanned legal documents are stored as PDFs in the cloud, but that is storage, not a documented export of all data. The API is gated behind a contact request and has no public documentation, so at most it is a developer building block for building an export yourself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
